title: Adaptive QoS model experiments
evidence_type: simulated model output; not physical-router or ISP measurement

methodology.paired_conditions: Each policy within a scenario uses the same fixed seed, generated flow workload, configured capacity, and number of ticks.

policy_definitions.no_qos: One shared FIFO queue, with offered-load-proportional service and no class priority.
policy_definitions.static_qos: Separate class queues with the project's fixed DEFAULT_POLICIES minima, caps, weights, and priorities; no intent or congestion-triggered reweighting.
policy_definitions.adaptive: Separate class queues; congestion-sensitive interactive weight boost based on offered load versus estimated capacity, plus the existing temporary-intent policy path.

methodology.latency_p95: 95th percentile of per-tick modeled interactive latency within each run.
methodology.jitter: Mean tick-to-tick modeled queue-delay change; not packet-level jitter.
methodology.packet_loss: Dropped packets divided by arrived packets across the run.
methodology.fairness: Mean per-tick Jain fairness over active generated flow rates.
methodology.cpu: Local Python process CPU time per simulated tick; not router CPU overhead.
methodology.adaptation: Adaptive capacity estimate first reaches within 10% of the configured 20 Mbps after the tick-8 capacity step.
